author: KaptenMelle
body: I got banned on this account. I really wanted to play on avicus so I made a new account for 2.25 euro! Then when i should join avicus I was ban evaded! Please unban me! I won't hack. This was 2 months ago! My other account is MrMelle!

title: Why Did I Get Banned On My 2nd Account Also?

replies.author: Junr
replies.body: You got banned on your second account since you were evading your ban from your first account. Evading bans are not allowed on the Avicus Network.
